scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Your base level is too low, come back when you hit level 130.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
您的基礎等級太低了，請達到130級後再來。

scripts.text: ^ff0000If you do any monster processing, such as monster taming within the dungeon, it won't count towards your progress. Please take note.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000在副本中馴服魔物等處理方式不會計入任務進度，請留意。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Oh, a curious onlooker? I'm Marry Jay, the person in charge of Fridays among the days of the week.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
哦，來湊熱鬧的嗎？我是瑪麗·傑伊，一週七天裡，星期五由我負責。

scripts.text: When is the opening time?
scripts.translation: 開放時間是什麼時候？

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
The dungeon will be open during:
^0000FFFriday 00:00 ~ Friday 23:59^000000
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
副本開放時間：
^0000FF星期五 00:00 ~ 星期五 23:59^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
I hope to see you when Friday arrives~
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
期待星期五到來時與您相見~

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Sorry, but the entry period to the {0} has expired.
Take a rest while waiting for the dungeon to be available again.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
很抱歉，{0}的入場時間已經結束。
先休息一下，等副本再次開放吧。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
The cooldown has expired.
You may re-enter the Memorial Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
冷卻時間已結束，可以再次進入記憶副本了。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
You came just in time.
The memorial dungeon is just ready to be opened.
Would you like to enter now?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
您來得正好，記憶副本已經準備就緒。
現在要進去嗎？

scripts.text: Enter Friday Memorial
scripts.translation: 進入週五記憶副本

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
The Memorial Dungeon has been created.
You may now enter.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
記憶副本已建立，現在可以進入了。

scripts.text: Only party members can enter this Memorial dungeon.
scripts.translation: 只有隊伍成員才能進入此記憶副本。

scripts.text: There is no Memorial Dungeon registered.
scripts.translation: 尚未登記記憶副本。

scripts.text:
The Friday Memorial Dungeon does not exist.
Your party leader has not yet created the Memorial dungeon.
scripts.translation:
週五記憶副本尚未建立。
您的隊長還沒有建立記憶副本。

scripts.text: An unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
去吧！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
You have not prepared?
Can't really help it I guess
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
您還沒準備好嗎？
那我也沒辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Before we start setting up the environment here, we'll give you the chance to choose an appropriate difficulty level.
I could make my own choice, but each person handles it differently based on their abilities.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
佈置這裡之前，先讓您選個合適的難度吧。
我倒是可以替您選，不過每個人的實力不同，能應付的難度也不一樣。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消
200級以上

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
You can't choose this difficulty, because your base level is below 200.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
由於您的基礎等級低於200級，無法選擇此難度。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Your base level is too low to select this, you need to be level {0} or above.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑伊]
您的基礎等級太低，無法選擇此項，需要達到{0}級或以上。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of objects. Clear your inventory.
scripts.translation: 您擁有的物品種類太多。請清理您的背包。

scripts.text: Can't continue because you have too many heavy objects. Reduce your total weight by clearing your inventory.
scripts.translation:
您的負重過高，無法繼續。
請清理背包，減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
If you bring me a {0}, I can enchant a wonderful effect on your accessory!
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
帶來{0}，我就能為您的飾品附上奇妙的效果！

scripts.text: What can you do with the Crafting Stone?
scripts.translation: 附魔原石有什麼用？

scripts.text: Accessory Enchantment
scripts.translation: 飾品附魔

scripts.text: Reset Enchant
scripts.translation: 重置附魔

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I trade expensive stones from the dungeon in exchange for my craftsmanship. I'm still a beginner, but my skills are passable.
Please take care of me.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
我提供附魔手藝，收取副本里出產的貴重石頭作為報酬。
雖然還是個新手，不過手藝還過得去。
請多關照。

scripts.text: I've heard this before.
scripts.translation: 我聽過這些了

scripts.text: I'm listening.
scripts.translation: 我在聽

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Is that so?
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
By using the Craft Stone, I can enchant one of your accessories with abilities.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
使用附魔原石，就能為您的一件飾品附加能力。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I need 10 x {0} and 100,000 Zeny.
There is no failure in the enchantment process.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
我需要10個{0}和100,000 Zeny。
附魔過程不會失敗。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
However ^0000FFif the accessory has a random option, the random option will be removed after enchantment.^000000
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
不過，^0000FF如果飾品帶有隨機屬性，附魔後這些隨機屬性就會消失。^000000

scripts.text: Anything else?
scripts.translation: 還有其他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Cards slotted to the accessory will remain after the enchantement.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
鑲嵌在飾品上的卡片在附魔後會保留。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
A reset is possible, but I can't say that I'm experienced.
My success rate is:
Royal Ring: 80%
Other Accessory: 20%
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
可以重置，不過我的經驗還不太足。
成功率如下：
皇家戒指：80%
其他飾品：20%

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
^0000FFIf the accessory has a random option, the random option will be removed after initialization.^000000
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
^0000FF如果飾品帶有隨機屬性，重置後這些隨機屬性就會消失。^000000

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Please equip your accessory.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
請裝備您的飾品。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I cannot {0} this {1} accessory.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
我無法{0}這個{1}飾品。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
The {0} already has maximum enchantment.
I cannot work on this any further.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
{0}的附魔已經達到上限，不能再繼續了。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Please select an enchantment type~
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
請選擇附魔型別~

scripts.text: Physical
scripts.translation: 物理

scripts.text: Magical
scripts.translation: 魔法

scripts.text: Ranged
scripts.translation: 遠端

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Are you sure to enhance the {0}?
^0000FFThere is a no chance of failure^000000.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
確定要為{0}附魔嗎？
^0000FF附魔一定成功^000000。

scripts.text: Yes, please proceed
scripts.translation: 是的，請繼續

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Please bring me 10 x {0}.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
請給我10個{0}。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I need 100,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
我需要100,000 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
The {0} has been enchanted!!
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
{0}已經附魔完成！！

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
The {0} already has an enchant.
I cannot work on this any further.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
{0}已經附魔過，不能再繼續了。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Are you sure you want to enhance the {0}?
^0000FFThere is a no chance of failure^000000.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
確定要為{0}附魔嗎？
^0000FF附魔一定成功^000000。

scripts.text: Yes, please proceed
scripts.translation: 是的，請繼續

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Please bring me 10 x {0}.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
請給我10個{0}。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I need 100,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
我需要100,000 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
The {0} has been enchanted with {1}.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
{0}已經附魔了{1}。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
The {0} is not at its maximum enchantment.
I cannot reset this accessory.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
{0}的附魔尚未達到上限，無法重置。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
All enchanted effects will be removed from the {0}?
^FF0000There is a {1}% chance of success. The accessory will be destroyed if the reset fails!^000000
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
確定要移除{0}上的所有附魔效果嗎？
^FF0000成功率為{1}%。如果重置失敗，飾品將會被銷燬！^000000

scripts.text: I'll be back later
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來

scripts.text: Please proceed
scripts.translation: 請繼續

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Please bring me 10 x {0}
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
請帶來10個{0}。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I need 100,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
我需要100,000 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Darn it...
I have failed and the accessory has been destroyed. I'm so sorry.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
糟了...重置失敗，飾品損毀了。
實在抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I have succeeded.
The {0} has been initialized.
scripts.translation:
[業餘收藏家]
成功了，{0}的附魔已經重置。
